reviews.title: Pointless
reviews.text:
They call this an “idle clicker” game, and that about sums it up. You tap the screen endlessly to earn entropy points so you can level up life on Earth, and you accumulate points when not logged into the game.

But here’s the thing: you just tap until another opportunity to serve an ad shows up. You can say no and keep tapping, but soon you get to a point where you need literal Quadrillions of entropy points to evolve. Even if you get 40,000,000,000 entropy points per tap, do you know how long it will take to reach a quadrillion? A loooong time.

Skip this game. It’s not informative, you don’t play an active roll in evolving lifeforms, and it’s literally built around tapping the screen until ad opportunities pop up.

reviews.title: Misleading reviews, very repetitive
reviews.text:
This game could have amazing potential, especially as a passive idle game with excellent science education. 

The problem is that there are three main missions, and they just repeat over and over. I’ve been playing for a month. I’m now on the 40th iteration of the dinosaur mission because at least it introduces a new species while you literally advance through every species you’ve unlocked. I’ve stopped playing the primary mission at 7 because there haven’t been new species introduced. 

The special missions are repeated and short. They had a cat and a deep sea mission that’s about 12 tasks. I’ve played them both twice in a month. You cannot advance past 250 without a lot of ads or paying for a pass. It’s absurdly difficult to get in the top 100 even with a paid pass because the game isn’t a passive idle. You’ve got to be tapping on screen for the most income.

reviews.title: Best idle game on the App Store
reviews.text:
Out of all the idle games on here, this one is by far the best. Here’s why.

1. No ads that interrupt your playing experience.
2. Currency to buy things can be earned by just playing. If you want more, you can also buy some with real money to support the developers.
3. Really well-implemented prestige system. 
4. Unlimited replayability.
5. Multiple things to do so you never get bored. Once you’re done upgrading one branch, you can switch to a different one.
6. Multiple platforms supported without losing features going from one platform to another.

This is the only idle game that I actively play. I usually come back to it an hour or two after closing it. Thank you developers for this amazing game!
